title: Judge indefinitely blocks Trump White House from banning 3 media outlets
summary: A federal judge has indefinitely blocked the Trump administration's attempt to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN, and Politico from reporting at the White House. The ruling protects press freedom and affirms media access rights to cover the executive branch.
content: President Donald Trump had sought to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN and Politico from reporting from the White House.

zh.title: 法官无限期阻止特朗普白宫禁止3家媒体
zh.summary: 联邦法官已无限期阻止特朗普政府禁止《美国现在》、CNN和《政治》杂志在白宫报道的企图。该裁决维护了新闻自由，并确认了媒体的白宫采访权。

title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
summary: China's customs agency released September trade data showing both exports and imports surpassed expectations. The stronger-than-anticipated trade figures signal solid economic momentum despite domestic slowdown concerns.
content: The country's customs agency released September trade data on Wednesday.

zh.title: 中国9月出口和进口激增，超过预期
zh.summary: 中国海关发布的9月贸易数据显示出口和进口均超过预期。这些超预期的贸易数据表明，尽管国内增长放缓，但经济动力仍保持强劲。

title: China's producer prices rise at fastest pace since June 2022, beating expectations
summary: China's producer prices rose at their fastest pace since June 2022, exceeding economist forecasts of 4.5% and the previous month's 3.8%. The increase signals growing inflationary pressures in manufacturing and production sectors.
content: The increase was higher than the 4.5% expected by economists polled by Reuters, and higher than the 3.8% seen in the previous month.

zh.title: 中国生产者价格创2022年6月以来最大涨幅，超过预期
zh.summary: 中国生产者价格自2022年6月以来以最快速度上升，超过了经济学家预测的4.5%和上月的3.8%。这一上升表明制造业和生产部门的通胀压力持续增长。

title: Taiwan agrees to buy 30% of gas from Alaska LNG project, Trump says
summary: President Trump announced that Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of gas production from an Alaska LNG project. The deal represents a significant energy partnership with geopolitical implications for US-Taiwan relations.
content: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday that Taiwan had agreed to buy 30% of the gas from a pipeline project in Alaska.

zh.title: 台湾同意购买阿拉斯加液化天然气项目30%产能，特朗普宣布
zh.summary: 特朗普宣布台湾已同意从阿拉斯加液化天然气项目购买30%的产气量。该协议代表了一项重大的能源伙伴关系，对美台关系具有地缘政治意义。

title: South Korean carmaker Hyundai plans 'strategic' investment of $15.5 billion in India by 2032
summary: Hyundai announced plans to invest $15.5 billion in India through 2032, identifying India as a strategic core market. The major commitment reflects automakers' focus on high-growth emerging markets and rising vehicle demand.
content: Korean car company Hyundai says India is a strategic core market

zh.title: 现代汽车计划到2032年向印度进行155亿美元"战略性"投资
zh.summary: 现代宣布计划到2032年在印度投资155亿美元，将印度确定为战略核心市场。这一重大承诺反映了汽车制造商对高增长新兴市场和不断增长的车辆需求的关注。

title: Oil rises amid growing Mideast tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia
summary: Oil prices rose as escalating tensions between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia raised concerns over potential Middle East supply disruptions. Geopolitical instability in the region continues to influence global energy markets.
content: Worries over supply disruptions due to escalating tensions in the Middle East helped to push oil prices higher.

zh.title: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间中东局势升温，油价上升
zh.summary: 伊朗支持的胡塞武装与沙特阿拉伯之间的紧张局势升级，引发了对中东潜在供应中断的担忧，油价随之上升。该地区地缘政治不稳定局势继续影响全球能源市场。

title: Stock futures are little changed as traders await consumer inflation report: Live updates
summary: Stock futures remained little changed as investors awaited a consumer inflation report, while weakness in chip stocks and mixed bank earnings weighed on major indices. Economic data releases continue to drive market sentiment ahead of the inflation data.
content: A slide in chip stocks and mixed bank results on Tuesday weighed on the major averages.

zh.title: 股指期货涨跌不大，交易员等待消费者物价报告：实时更新
zh.summary: 股指期货基本持平，投资者等待消费者物价报告发布，芯片股疲软和银行业绩不佳对主要股指造成压力。在物价数据前夕，经济数据持续推动市场情绪。

title: Anthropic urges court in Washington, D.C. to rehear appeal of Pentagon blacklisting
summary: Anthropic petitioned a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal of the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models. The case highlights ongoing regulatory scrutiny and security concerns surrounding AI technology in government procurement.
content: Anthropic is asking a federal court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal in a case concerning the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company's AI models.

zh.title: Anthropic敦促华盛顿特区法院重新听证对五角大楼黑名单的上诉
zh.summary: Anthropic向华盛顿特区联邦法院请愿，要求重新听证其对五角大楼将该公司AI模型列入黑名单的上诉。该案凸显了有关政府采购AI技术的持续监管审查和安全担忧。

title: Singapore third-quarter GDP growth softens from four-year high but beats estimates
summary: Singapore's third-quarter GDP growth moderated from a four-year high but still beat economist expectations of 5% growth. The data reflects continued economic expansion in the city-state, though at a slower pace than recent quarters.
content: The GDP print beat expectations of a 5% growth from economists polled by Reuters.

zh.title: 新加坡三季度GDP增速从四年高位回落，但仍超预期
zh.summary: 新加坡第三季度GDP增长从四年高位温和放缓，但仍超过经济学家预期的5%增速。这一数据表明该城市国家经济继续扩张，尽管增速相比近期季度有所减缓。
